Kamp 
Hanawana 


September 1976 
Greetings to all Kanawanians! 


The summer of 1976 has ended. We had 480 different kampers at 
K.K. this year from all over the world. Kampers from England, 


France, Germany, Africa, Mexico, as well as Edmonton, Toronto, 
Ottawa, Quebec City, P.E.1., Newfoundland, New York City, Los 
Angeles and, of course, Montreal. | sincerely hope that the 
friendships made at kamp will continue throughout the winter. 
IMPORTANT LOST _& FOUND 

This has been a record year for kampers (and staff) leaving 
things behind. If you are missing anything, either you or your 
parents should drop by to claim it. As fn years past, all 
unclaimed articles will be donated to a local charity. 

Details: 


Date: Now until September 24, 1976 
Time: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM 
(Monday to Friday) 
Place: Kamp Office 
1441 Drummond Street 


Montreal 
We do have a list of some of the lost and found articles. I+ 
may save you a trip if you give us a call first. 


The enclosed letter is for your parents. Please pass It on to 
them. Thanks. 


In the next month or so, you and your parents will receive some 
information about winter skiing at kamp "The Kanawana Outing 
Club". 


1'm on my way back up to kamp now for final closing. 


Best wishes for a successful year at school and please give my 
regards to your family. 


Yours in Kamping, 


BVW/h 
gncl. 


THE GREEN TRIANGLE
